title: Cart total omits the shipping charge
description: When the cart subtotal is below the free-shipping threshold, the displayed Total shows only the merchandise subtotal instead of subtotal plus the visible shipping charge.

steps: Observe the Shipping and Total values
report.expected: With a .00 Keyboard and .00 shipping, Total should display .00.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an initially empty cart.

steps: When the cart subtotal is below the free-shipping threshold, the displayed Total shows only the merchandise subtotal instead of subtotal plus the visible shipping charge.
